explanation: The children of David, the second king of Israel, who reigned around 1000 BC.
The capital city of Israel and an important religious center for Judaism.
One of David's sons and his successor on the throne; known for his wisdom and for building the temple in Jerusalem.
Solomon's son and the first king of Judah after the kingdom was divided into two.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel and later a separate kingdom after the division of the realm.
The period when the Jews were taken captive and lived in Babylon (approx. 586-539 BC).
A descendant of King David and father to Zerubbabel, a leader during the rebuilding of the temple after the exile.
